Why it was rejected 15

These come from the pipeline's final QC. Fix them, then upload a new version of this task and run the Delivery Gate again.

error
Aggregate fails because two mandatory subchecks fail. (a) instruction_verifier_consistency: the six memo regexes in tests/verifier.json (e.g. memo_disputes_loan_b_with_reference_amounts_and_reason) impose a reward-bearing requirement found nowhere in instruction.md — the invoice reference, a numeric amount and a reason keyword must all appear on the SAME physical line of interest_memo.md. (b) solution_instruction_consistency: instruction.md:25 states 'the total row must carry an empty reference column', but solution/files/interest_review.csv's last row is 'Total,,421312.33,...' i.e. 'Total' is in the reference column and the description is empty. Otherwise the package is coherent: gold deliverables pass all 25 declared checks (verified by replaying every assertion in tests/verifier.json against solution/files/*), inputs support the arithmetic, and environment/Dockerfile matches the declared offline non-connector task.

Correct the task-quality finding and submit a new version.

error
Every graded value traces to the instruction (CSV amounts, total, results.json keys), but six of the seven memo checks add an undisclosed surface-form requirement: the regexes are (?mi)^...$ anchored, so reference + amount + reason keyword must co-occur on one physical line. instruction.md only asks the memo to 'set out each line we are disputing and why...'.
